fixed_physical_regime.solver: explicit Yee, Esirkepov, dt = 0.9 * multidimensional CFL

pairing: same seed across Ti/Te endpoints within each pair
sample_size: 3 fresh paired seeds per endpoint per fidelity; 12 scientific simulator runs

estimator.name: late_window_normalized_flux_slope_rate
estimator.formula: mu = alpha * ols_slope(flux_x_to_o_over_B0_di vs t_omegaci over t_omegaci in [6, 12])
estimator.flux_definition: flux_x_to_o = trapezoid(Bz at z=0 from x=0 to x=Lx/2) / (B0 * di), as implemented in guided/gem_collisionless.py
estimator.normalization: alpha = di * omega_ci / va_upstream; omega_ci = qe*B0/(mass_ratio*me); va_upstream = va_upstream_over_c * c

energy_quality_gate: per-run combined FieldEnergy total_lev0(J) + ParticleEnergy total(J) relative drift absolute value <= 2.0e-3 for a valid scientific observation

decision_rule.valid_group: at least 2 valid runs of 3 per (fidelity, endpoint)
decision_rule.R16: mean(mu, Ti/Te=1, ppc=16) / mean(mu, Ti/Te=20, ppc=16)
decision_rule.R8: mean(mu, Ti/Te=1, ppc=8) / mean(mu, Ti/Te=20, ppc=8)
decision_rule.supported: all four groups valid and R16 >= 1.25 and R8 >= 1.25
decision_rule.falsified: all four groups valid and R16 < 1.25
decision_rule.weakened: R16 >= 1.25 with valid groups but R8 < 1.25 (persistence control not established)
decision_rule.unresolved_or_instrument_limited: fewer than 2 valid runs in any group, or mean(mu, Ti/Te=20) <= 0 making the ratio ill-defined

uncertainty_report: seed-level SD and standard error of the endpoint means; paired per-seed ratios; 100000-resample paired bootstrap 95% percentile CI on R16 and R8; energies and window point counts per run

pipeline.analyzer: analyze_ensemble.py via capability Python (numpy), reading simulator summary JSON and exact-header reduced energy files
pipeline.freeze_order: author and stabilize analyzer before any evidence-stage simulator run; register claims, contracts, and bindings; commission both instruments; then execute all 12 scientific runs and one analyzer run
